title: Song sidecar (song.yaml)
description: Sidecar next to songs/<slug>/score.gp, written by the preprocess-song skill and by hand. See ADR-0013 and ADR-0015.

source.description: Where score.gp came from (the music/ inbox file).

date.description: Transcription date from the file name (YYYY-MM-DD).

bassTrack.description: Track name or zero-based index of the bass track in score.gp.

music.description: Audio rendered from the transcription, stored as audio.mp3 next to score.gp (ADR-0022).

source.description: Original MP3 file name from the music/ inbox.

offsetMs.description: Audio time of the score's first tick (lead-in), measured with inspect-song --audio.

cover.description: Album cover shown in the header, stored as cover.jpg next to score.gp and fetched with npm run fetch-cover (ADR-0026).

album.description: Album the cover belongs to: the original release of the recording the tab follows.

itunesId.description: iTunes collection id the artwork was taken from (npm run fetch-cover -- <slug> --id <itunesId>).

chunks.description: Ordered practice chunks. Required; the build does not invent chunks (ADR-0015).

bars.description: First and last bar, inclusive. Played bars: repeats are unrolled (ADR-0023).

tick.description: Offset from bar start at 960 PPQ.

lyrics.description: Lyrics (ADR-0024). By default the vocal track of score.gp gives synced lyrics, else `text` gives unsynced ones.

source.description: score: only the Guitar Pro vocal track; text: only `text`; none: no lyrics.

text.description: Unsynced lyrics as a YAML block scalar (`text: |`): one line per lyric line, blank lines between stanzas, `[Chorus]` lines as section labels.

track.description: Track name or zero-based index of the vocal track. Default: the track with the most sung syllables.

notes.description: Review notes from the skill or the owner.

sync.description: Anchors from score bar (a played bar, ADR-0023) to recording time. Linear interpolation with the tempo map between anchors.
